lede: Carolina Panthers carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#14 in EPA per play), while Philadelphia Eagles owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#6 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Philadelphia Eagles -1.5 with a fair total of 43.1 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Carolina Panthers pass offence vs Philadelphia Eagles pass defence, which sits −0.084 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Carolina Panthers and Philadelphia Eagles have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
